title: Prediction Space
text: The prediction vector $$Y_{hat}$$ is in the column space of X because it is the projection of Y onto col(X).

title: Residual Sign
text: $$Y_{hat}$$ - Y is the negative of the residual Y - $$Y_{hat}$$, so it has the same orthogonality relationships.

title: Column Space Check
text: If $$Y_{hat}$$ is in col(X) and $$Y_{hat}$$ - Y is orthogonal to col(X), what is the relationship between $$Y_{hat}$$ - Y and $$Y_{hat}$$?
choices: NOT orthogonal to and NOT in the span of

title: Apply to $$Y_{hat}$$
text: Because $$Y_{hat}$$ lies in col(X), and $$Y_{hat}$$ - Y is orthogonal to col(X), $$Y_{hat}$$ - Y is orthogonal to $$Y_{hat}$$.
